content: Permitted renovation hours are Monday to Friday: 09:00 - 17:00. Strictly NO noisy work or renovation permitted on Saturdays, Sundays, and Public Holidays. Heavy hacking and drilling are only allowed between 09:00 - 13:00 on weekdays to minimize disturbance. Contractors must register daily at the security guardhouse.

A refundable renovation deposit of $2,000 (standard units) or $3,000 (penthouses/large units) along with a non-refundable admin fee of $109 (inclusive of GST) must be submitted to the Managing Agent at least 7 working days prior to commencement of works. Deposit is refunded within 30 days after joint inspection confirms no damage to common property.

topic: Moving In, Moving Out & Delivery Regulations
content: Moving in/out must be booked with the Concierge / Managing Agent at least 3 business days in advance. Moving hours: Monday to Saturday 09:00 - 17:00. Strictly no moving activities on Sundays and Public Holidays. A refundable deposit of $500 is required for lift padding and protection. Max loading bay clearance height is 3.8m.

Aircon ledges are strictly reserved for condensing units. Residents are prohibited from placing storage items, racks, or clothes drying equipment on aircon ledges for safety and fire regulations. Balcony screens must comply with developer-approved motorized zip screen specifications and colors (Grey tone matching facade).

section: By-Law 6.4: Common Utility Risers & Telecom Access
content: Fiber broadband telecom risers are located at common lift lobbies on each floor and are kept locked for fire safety. To unlock the riser for OpenNet / NetLink Trust / Telco fiber installation technicians, residents or their contractors must request the master riser key from the Ground Floor Security Guardhouse / Concierge. The technician's pass must be deposited.

Gymnasium: 06:00 - 22:00 daily (access via resident RFID card / mobile app). Swimming Pool & Jacuzzi: 07:00 - 22:00 daily (cleaning on Tuesdays 08:00 - 11:00). BBQ Pavilions: Session 1 (10:00 - 15:00), Session 2 (17:00 - 22:00). BBQ bookings require a $50 refundable cleaning deposit. Max 10 guests per BBQ booking.

section: By-Law 9.1: Car Park System & Resident Season Parking
content: Lentor Modern utilizes an Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) / In-Vehicle Unit (IU) carpark barrier system. Each residential unit is entitled to 1 complimentary first-car season parking lot. Second car applications are subject to availability and council balloting at $150/month. Visitor parking rates apply after a 15-minute grace period.

The 12-month Defects Liability Period (DLP) begins from the Notice of Vacant Possession. Residents must log defects via the official GuocoLand resident mobile app or submit the Defect List to the Customer Service Centre / Handover Office on Level 4. Defect contractor appointments must be confirmed with the Handover team.
